caption: The drawing shows a wooden sofa with rolled arms and ornate, carved legs. The frame of the sofa is brown, suggesting polished wood. The seat, the back cushion, and the inner side of the arms are upholstered with a patterned fabric. The fabric is predominantly a dull olive or moss green color, decorated with a floral motif featuring pink, blue, and red flowers with green leaves and curling yellow stems or decorative elements. The floral pattern is repeated across the upholstery. The sofa is centered on a plain, light background and is enclosed in a double rectangular border. The drawing is rendered in color, and the artist’s name, “MAGNUS S. FOSSUM,” is written in the lower left corner outside the border.
title: High Back Lounge
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
